summary: Lorenzo il Magnifico is a heavier Euro combining worker placement with dice-based action strength, where you develop cards across military, territory, character, and building tracks toward a strong end-game engine. The Big Box bundles the base game with several expansions adding variety and player powers.
praised: deep strategic depth with meaningful choices
great variable player powers via leader cards
criticised: long playtime and setup, especially with expansions
steep learning curve for new players
can suffer analysis paralysis at higher player counts

interaction.kind: worker/dice placement contention and blocking key spaces

scoring.why: points accumulate from military, territory, character, and building cards plus resources converted at game end
